texto:
Urban gardening is becoming very popular in big cities. People are using small spaces to grow their own food. You can see little gardens on balconies, rooftops, and even in community areas. This trend started because many people want to eat healthier food and know where it comes from. It's a great way to have fresh vegetables and herbs right at home.

This activity is not just about food. It also helps people connect with nature, which can be difficult in a large city. Community gardens are special because they bring neighbors together. People share tools, seeds, and advice. They work together and build stronger relationships. This makes the neighborhood a friendlier place.

Starting an urban garden is not very difficult. You don't need a big space. A few pots on a sunny balcony are enough to grow things like tomatoes, lettuce, or mint. It is a relaxing and rewarding hobby.

preguntas.pregunta: What is the main topic of the text?

opciones.A: The problems of living in big cities.
opciones.B: The best types of vegetables to grow.
opciones.C: The trend of growing food in urban areas.
opciones.D: The history of gardening around the world.
opciones.E: How to sell produce from a community garden.

preguntas.explicacion: La respuesta correcta es C porque todo el texto describe la jardinería en las ciudades. Frases como 'Urban gardening is becoming very popular in big cities' y 'People are using small spaces to grow their own food' muestran que el tema principal es la tendencia de cultivar alimentos en zonas urbanas. The other options are incorrect: The text focuses on a positive activity, not problems (A); it mentions some vegetables but doesn't detail the 'best types' (B); it's about urban areas, not world history (D); and it never mentions selling produce (E).

preguntas.pregunta: From the text, we can infer that urban gardening...

opciones.A: is only possible for people with large houses.
opciones.B: is a very expensive and complex hobby.
opciones.C: can improve social connections in a neighborhood.
opciones.D: is less healthy than buying food from a store.
opciones.E: requires a lot of professional training.

preguntas.explicacion: La respuesta correcta es C. El texto no dice directamente que la jardinería urbana 'improves social connections', pero podemos deducirlo. Menciona que los huertos comunitarios 'bring neighbors together' (juntan a los vecinos) y ayudan a 'build stronger relationships' (construir relaciones más fuertes), lo que implica una mejora en las conexiones sociales. The other options are incorrect: The text says 'You don't need a big space' (A); it states it is 'not very difficult', implying it isn't complex or necessarily expensive (B, E); and people do it to 'eat healthier food' (D).
